title: Print start: X and Y homed by the plate check are not homed a second time (optional)
note: OPTIONAL (install with --with start-keep-xy). QIDI's PRINT_START homes all axes at its beginning, also when X and Y were homed a moment before. With this module that first homing can keep X and Y and home only Z, the same way as before (bed 5 mm down, nozzle to the middle, probe with the nozzle); expected saving about 9-10 s. Two modes, chosen in the console and remembered: TWEAKED_START_XY MODE=CHECK (default, careful; needs ai-fixes and its foreign-object check switched on): only when the check of this start has just homed X and Y itself and went through without a report, pause, cancel or Continue. TWEAKED_START_XY MODE=ANY: whenever X and Y count as homed (Home on the screen or in Fluidd, an earlier cancel). Risk of ANY: the printer cannot tell a real position from a wrong one - after a pushed head or lost steps with the motors on, or after a position forced with SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION, the head goes to the middle, the nozzle cleaning and the filament cutter work with that wrong position and the head can hit the frame. (The printer screen forces such a position when it moves an axis that is not homed, and switches the motors off right after the move, which forgets it: seen on the author's printer on 27.11.2026.) In both modes 'Home All', the second homing of PRINT_START (after the filament cutter) and a print start with X or Y not homed home everything. No print start with it has been tried yet. Uninstall restores QIDI's lines.
